data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Aug(us) meaning 'great' or 'magnificent'. This name has been popular in Christian tradition due to Saint Augustine of Hippo, a renowned philosopher, theologian, and bishop. The name Augie carries the meaning “Great, Magnificent” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Augie usually hope their child will grow to embody great, magnificent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
